description: Build a link that opens OrbitStudio Sky with the night sky over a place on Earth at a local date and time, as a 3D-printable star map plate. Use it for a birth, wedding or 'night we met' star map. Give the coordinates yourself; this tool does not look up place names.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees east (negative is west).

place.description: Optional label engraved on the plate, e.g. 'Amsterdam, Netherlands'.

name: star_map_link
title: Star map link
